# LDE Dev

> LDE Dev publishes Android apps for tracking exchange rates and converting currencies. Ringgit Today focuses on the Malaysian ringgit (MYR), and SGD Today focuses on the Singapore dollar (SGD).

The app pages describe features, supported currencies, and how to find exchange rates in each app. Use the apps for the latest available rates.

## Official website

- [LDE Dev](https://leonovde.github.io/): Publisher homepage.
- [Android apps](https://leonovde.github.io/android-apps/): Catalogue of currency apps by LDE Dev.

## Apps

- [Ringgit Today](https://leonovde.github.io/android-apps/ringgit-today/): Malaysian ringgit exchange-rate tracker and currency converter for Android.
- [SGD Today](https://leonovde.github.io/android-apps/sgd-today/): Singapore dollar exchange-rate tracker and currency converter for Android.

## Optional

- [Ringgit Today privacy policy](https://leonovde.github.io/android-apps/ringgit-today/privacy-policy/)
- [SGD Today privacy policy](https://leonovde.github.io/android-apps/sgd-today/privacy-policy/)
